cloud.title: Tion
cloud.description: Enter your Tion / MagicAir cloud credentials.

ble.title: Tion 4S over Bluetooth
ble.description: Breezers seen by Home Assistant Bluetooth adapters and ESPHome proxies: {found}. If the list is empty, enter the MAC address manually. A breezer bound to MagicAir does not advertise — unbind it or switch MagicAir off first.

ble_pair.title: Pairing {name}
ble_pair.description: Put {name} ({address}) into pairing mode: in standby (yellow LED) hold the power button for about 5 seconds until the LED blinks blue. Then press Submit within ~30 seconds. A Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy must be within a few metres of the breezer.

error.client_rejected: Cloud rejected client_id/secret — Tion updated their mobile app. Capture fresh credentials (see tools/debug_auth.py).
error.grant_deprecated: Tion disabled password-grant (unsupported_grant_type). Auth must be migrated to OAuth code-flow with PKCE.
error.endpoint_gone: Endpoint api2.magicair.tion.ru is gone (404/410). Cloud moved to a new domain — check HA logs.
error.captcha: Cloud returned HTML (likely Cloudflare/captcha). Your IP may be blocked.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach api2.magicair.tion.ru. Check your internet/DNS.
error.unknown: Authentication failed for an unknown reason. See HA logs (enable DEBUG for custom_components.tion).
error.invalid_address: MAC address must look like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.ble_not_found: The breezer is not visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant.
error.ble_pair_failed: Pairing failed. Make sure the LED blinks blue and nothing else (MagicAir, phone app) is connected, then try again.
error.ble_not_4s: The device answered, but it is not a Tion 4S.

abort.already_configured: This account or breezer is already configured.
